About

Yuanchao Wang

I am a Research Associate at New York University. I received my Master’s degree from the Pratt School of Engineering at Duke University in 2025.

My research focuses on reliable learning under distribution shift, heterogeneity, and unreliable samples. This work has evolved from shifts across environments to sample-level reliability, and more recently to training distributions generated by the model itself.

Research trajectory

  • OOD-TV-IRM. Robust correction under environment-level distribution shift.
  • ECTR. Sample-level adversarial reweighting for heterogeneity within each environment.
  • ShellOOD. A geometric, self-supervised approach to detecting samples outside the reliable support of the training distribution.
  • CROSS. Verified, recoverable local corrections for robust on-policy self-distillation under an evolving student-generated distribution.

Read my publications or explore the ideas behind my projects.
